claim: DIVERSITY GATE: at matched compute, a parallel swarm produces more DISTINCT verified solutions per task than a single eratchet lineage
expected: on tasks both arms solve, swarm mean distinct-verified-solutions >= 1.5x eratchet, OR >= +1 distinct on at least half the shared-solved tasks, with arms within +/-20% total tokens
falsifier: swarm distinct <= eratchet at matched compute => the swarm produces no richer corpus => write-back-via-swarm is dead; do NOT run stage B (no diversity-prompt retry)
note: cheap gate; measured by drydock.swarm.candidate_diversity. Prior FAVORS this direction (write-back is the real lever), but the gate can still fail if the swarm makes N copies of one solve.

claim: DOWNSTREAM LIFT: self-distilling on the diverse swarm corpus beats the eratchet corpus at EQUAL corpus size on held-out tasks
expected: swarm-corpus-distilled model solves more held-out tbench-2 tasks than the eratchet-corpus model, beyond the ratchet's known n=1 variance band, at equal example count
falsifier: held-out lift within noise or not greater => diversity did not translate to model improvement => swarm write-back value unproven; do not claim a ratchet improvement
note: equal corpus SIZE so diversity is the only variable. Only run if p1 holds.

claim: REAL DIVERSITY: the swarm's distinct-solution advantage is genuine approach diversity, not cosmetic variants
expected: after semantic dedup (not just text-normalized diff), the swarm's distinct-solution advantage over eratchet survives
falsifier: the advantage collapses under semantic dedup (it was whitespace/comment/format variants) => inflated diversity; fix dedup and re-gate before stage B
note: guards against candidate_diversity overcounting cosmetic differences.
